basic_info.description: Charming one bedroom, one bathroom unit with hardwood floors. Bright eat-in kitchen with tile floors and leads out to shared deck area. Cozy bedroom with french doors leading to charming office space. Washer/dryer in unit. Close to shops and cafes on Castro Street.Available November 1st, 2014. 12 month lease only. Security deposit is 1.5 times monthly rent. Applications can be found on www.pacunionpm.com. $30.00 application fee per applicant. Proof of income required.
